import os,json,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
binary=Path(os.environ['SWARM_REPORTED_COSTS_BINARY']).resolve()
base=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='reported-cost-admin-fault-',dir='.cache')).resolve()
output=base/'run'
r=subprocess.run(['node','tests/reported_cost_admin_ui.cjs',str(binary),str(output)],env={**os.environ,'SWARM_REPORTED_COST_ADMIN_INJECT_PAGE_ERROR':'1'})
if r.returncode!=1:raise ValueError('browser fault did not refuse')
witness=json.loads((output/'valid-witness.json').read_bytes())
if not witness['loaded'] or witness['schema_version']!=32:raise ValueError('missing valid same-flow witness')
failure=json.loads((output/'failure.json').read_bytes())
if 'fixture page fault' not in failure['message'] or not failure['errors']:raise ValueError('missing browser failure cause')
if (output/'result.json').exists():raise ValueError('fault became pass')
print('PASS browser error interrupts pending Admin verification without watchdog',flush=True)
print('REPLAY_EVIDENCE '+str(base),flush=True)
